title: Heavy Honeyed Egyptian Date Cake
description: A sweet and juicy Egyptian dessert featuring icing sugar and a unique ferment-kimchi twist, made vegan-friendly with plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, icing sugar, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, mix together the dates, ferment kimchi, honey, and coconut oil.
Add the vanilla extract to the wet ingredients and stir well.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool completely.
Once the cake is cool, slice it into squares and serve.
